0ca1450969b5beb5.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to ChatGPT users worldwide together with Intelligent UI, which answers with visuals and interactive elements instead of plain text.
0ca1450969b5beb5.benefit: You can try GPT-6 in ChatGPT today; interactive, visual answers make data-heavy explanations easier to explore.

dd66acaed2a04b44.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol is a new OpenAI model for coding, computer use, and professional work, delivering near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth of Astra's API token prices.
dd66acaed2a04b44.benefit: If you run Astra-level workloads through the API, Sol can cut input and output token costs to a fifth for similar coding and agent tasks.

8e206c4d9ed6ea5b.summary: OpenAI published a practical guide for startups on choosing GPT-6 models, tuning reasoning effort, improving prompts and skills, and coordinating tools for production.
8e206c4d9ed6ea5b.benefit: A ready checklist for taking a GPT-6 prototype to production, especially for picking reasoning effort and tool setups.
